messages:
maya: quick thread finalizing validation UX for Console > Model Pins. three patterns: inline-only, top-summary+anchors, compact summary. also required marker choice and delete-confirm behavior. pinging for quick takes. dan: can you drop the artboards here? mobile is a big constraint. maya: pasted two tiny artboards. summary+anchors looks promising for keyboard/screen-reader flows. sophia: +1 for top-summary+anchors. make the summary an alert (role="alert" aria-live="assertive") and move focus to it on submit failure. summary items should anchor -> focus input. oliver: prefer explicit "(required)" text after labels. asterisk + color alone is insufficient. marco: typed confirm for irreversible deletes or bulk deletes (>10 items). for single quick deletes, modal with a checkbox and focus trap is fine. require admin role for bulk deletion. dan: a11y nit: set aria-invalid="true" on invalid inputs and link inline error text with aria-describedby. on desktop focus summary; on mobile auto-scroll to first inline error. a11y-bot: WCAG reminder: do not use color alone to indicate required state. ensure error outlines meet 3:1 contrast for UI components. sophia: UX rule idea: if error count > 3 expand the summary by default and mute inline noise. maya: copy suggestions: header = "Please fix these fields to continue". typed confirm: "Type DELETE to permanently remove this model pin." short and explicit. maya: small snippet I'll include in the spec:

Please fix these fields to continue

  • Model name is required
maya: I'll update Figma + post the short spec in ~20m. thanks all!"
